verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents a Web API at webapi.teamviewer.com/api/v1/docs/index, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows that API documentation exists. Nothing indicates the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec at standard paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
